question: Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2d1132365f54f33bd28cf4638d4cd8f84518d064e9f20cd8a641dba839d056f.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The shape rotates 45º in the clockwise direction and two circles are added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc7e878456c1b7383551f559883db0d8eb9bdfa83c929c02ba07d37a236f3ddc.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The shape rotates 45º in the clockwise direction and two circles are added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46d85a43cb736d311b022224ee03efb04efb428fe05a8c2fe7ee9db54c55dda1.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The shape rotates 45º in the clockwise direction and two circles are added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efbed2b67e2606499c690e41a5b8a01ff0de4d32d7e87fcb32d6bdfc36b7b77e.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

The shape rotates 45º in the clockwise direction and two circles are added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88a4a69fef49e4890bc52f99613dc4e2a5445a67f203aeb5aff4d0f322be61e6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**
